title: Maternal influences on infant gut microbiome and health.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Downloaded the two public MAG (metagenome-assembled genome) metadata tables from Zenodo record 18965233 (CC-BY-4.0). They have 87,239 and 1,448 rows, with columns MAG_ID, Sample_ID, Completeness, Contamination, N50 and GTDB_lineage, and no phenotype columns. Confirmed that BioProject PRJNA1468137 holds raw reads only. The GitHub repo's demo data is simulated.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the clinical metadata and processed reads are controlled-access at EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) and need an application plus a data access agreement. The supplement listing timed out, so the Nature Source Data files were not inspected.

a1_downloadable.note: The outcome labels and clinical metadata are controlled-access at EGA (EGAD50000002677) and need an application. The public material has no labels (checked the files).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The public files contain no label column, only genome-quality and taxonomy fields (checked the files).

a3_inputs_present.note: Processed abundance profiles are not public. Only raw reads are, and raw sequencing data is out of scope.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable to the public MAG table.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not reconciled in detail. The MAG table's sample count is broadly consistent with the paper's 4,526 samples.

a8_label_provenance.note: Per the paper, the labels come from questionnaires and clinical records. Not verified.

honest_claim_h3: Not applicable: the labels are not publicly accessible.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the mother's gut bacteria around birth to predict whether her infant develops eczema.
plain_idea.train_on: Maternal gut bacterial abundance profiles from a Dutch birth cohort. The number of public labelled examples is zero; the paper reports 714 mother-infant pairs.
plain_idea.predict: Infant eczema status, recorded in the cohort's clinical and questionnaire data, which are controlled-access.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Early-warning markers for infant allergy would interest paediatric microbiome researchers, but the data would require an access application.

ml_idea: Predict infant outcomes from maternal microbiome profiles. Blocked because the labels are controlled-access.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because the evaluation stopped at Part A1.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check whether labels are public. They are not: they are controlled-access at EGA.

verdict_reason: Fails A1: all outcome labels and processed profiles are controlled-access at EGA and need an application. The public files are raw reads and MAG quality/taxonomy tables without labels.
